name: bench-fsf
title: archived .fsf files: FSL FEAT designs (Tcl), git-annex pointers, XML and a shader
labels: an LLM judge (Claude Sonnet 4.6), the study's rule agrees on all
sampling: population-sampled with weights (uniform by-file sample; FEAT designs drawn down to 300)
strengths: drawn uniformly from the archive's 21,802 .fsf files, with population weights
an extension no language claims: configuration in Tcl syntax, pointers that are not code
real file names and repositories (qualified SWHIDs)
weaknesses: labels by one LLM judge; no human check
Tcl for a FEAT design is a choice (its syntax); the judge calls it not a programming language
300 FEAT designs are near-duplicates generated by a GUI
the cascade's candidates and the rule were built from these files
